title: Honest Interval Length for Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity with Unknown Cutoff: Profile-Likelihood Envelopes
banked_reason: The promised total honest profile interval with all-strength minimax attainment is still an explicit open obligation; the delivered kernel is a computable lower frontier plus grid-aligned calibration, not the headline upper/attainment result.
gap_reasons: The promised total honest profile interval with all-strength minimax attainment is still an explicit open obligation; the delivered kernel is a computable lower frontier plus grid-aligned calibration, not the headline upper/attainment result.

Proving continuum-uniform honesty and L_n^star(kappa_n) asymp r_n attainment on R_cert with sieve, transfer, stochastic false-split, calibration, and fallback controls is faithful but is the original multi-crux open program, not a bounded D0 repair; a crux-encoding assumption is forbidden.

As defined over the declared strength shell kappa_n<=1/8, c_t=1/2+4t kappa_n is not in [1/4,3/4] (e.g. t=1, kappa_n=1/8 gives c_t=1); qualify this definition/witness by kappa_n<=1/16 or restrict t before calling P_t causal-valid.
proof_attempt_summary: The run constructed causal-valid moving- and fixed-cutoff continua, proved finite-sample KL/TV controls, explicit integrated lower envelopes, a global all-strength lower bound, flat-face nonshrinkage, population false-split separation, and singular-cell-safe finite-grid calibration. It did not establish continuum-uniform honesty, stochastic profile and fallback control, an attaining interval, or the exact finite-positive critical experiment; those missing pieces form the original multi-crux upper/attainment program rather than a bounded repair. The delivered lower and structural results are sound but support only an incremental contribution below the field floor.
tldr: For fuzzy regression discontinuity with a weak compliance jump and unknown cutoff, cutoff recovery and causal-effect informativeness are distinct. Integrating the moving-cutoff continuum gives the explicit lower value \(G_\alpha(\tau_n)\), while integrating the causal-valid fixed-cutoff bump continuum gives the new exact envelope \(F_{\alpha,s,M}(T_n)\). Thus \(L_n^\star(\kappa_n)\ge F_{\alpha,s,M}(T_n)\) at every declared strength, \(L_n^\star(\kappa_n)\ge\max\{G_\alpha(\tau_n),F_{\alpha,s,M}(T_n)\}\) when \(\kappa_n\le1/16\), and \(L_n^\star(\kappa_n)\gtrsim r_n\) globally under the unchanged binary H{\"o}lder-margin class. Finite-grid four-cell calibration remains valid for every compatible treatment--outcome association, including singular cells. The support-wide profile upper bound, attainment, the \(s=1\) finite-positive critical decision value, and full-model least favorability remain open.
gap: Known-cutoff weak-fuzzy inference, sharp-RD unknown-cutoff rates, generic weak-identification decision theory, and Bayesian propagation of cutoff uncertainty have been developed separately. None characterizes honest connected-interval length when the cutoff and fuzzy denominator weaken jointly.
fill: The project couples a legal moving-cutoff continuum with a support-wide four-cell population profile and a coarsened exact calibration that leaves association free. It evaluates the critical decision problems and seeks a total honest interval, with its conservative finite-grid upper-rate claim confined to the explicitly certifiable recovered regime.
